about.text: Kefalotyri is a hard, salty Greek and Cypriot cheese made from sheep's milk, goat's milk or a mix of the two, white to yellow depending on the milk. It is ripened for about three months or longer, and is eaten as it is, fried in olive oil as saganaki, or grated over dishes and into pies.

facts.v: Native S. thermophilus plus L. lactis grew best in the first 24 h; later mesophilic lactic bacteria and the L. plantarum adjunct (about 8.5 log CFU/g) dominated during ripening
Main volatiles are acetone, butyric acid, methyl butyrate and ethanol
A kefalotyri aged a year or more is drier and stronger
